name: Toudou Kasumi
source:
Job: Miko
Birthplace: Japan
Hobby: Watching Movies (Especially Horror)
Important Thing: A charm she got from a certain person.
Likes: Croquettes from a store on the way home from school, Napolitan
Hates: Her weekly lessons forced by her mother (Traditional dance, Flower arranging, Tea ceremony)
Special Skill: Aikido, Japanese Archery
